name: Stasya Tolstaya
bio: Stasia Tolstaya (Anastasia Pavlovna Tolstaya/Venkova; born December 19, 1997, Saint Petersburg) is a Russian actress, screenwriter and director of cinema and theater.

credits.title: Noise of Time
credits.overview: About one of the most famous composers of the 20th century, Dmitriy Dmitrievich Shostakovich.

credits.title: Minotaur
credits.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

credits.title: Chasing The White Rabbit
credits.overview: On the eve of an important casting, actor Mark goes out for a smoke and encounters the White Rabbit. He embarks on a surreal journey that radically changes his outlook on life.

credits.title: Family Happiness
credits.overview: After losing her parents, Masha falls in love with her guardian Sergei Mikhailovich. Masha is young, Sergei Mikhailovich is much older, and they have to go through a difficult path to understanding each other.

credits.title: Secret Passion
credits.overview: Veta is a student of the acting department of one of the capital's universities. She does not show great promise, but she firmly believes in her dream - to become the best in her field.

credits.title: The Flood
credits.overview: During the swimming training camp, coach Sofia and her husband, coach Trofim, take their niece, an orphan, to raise. Anya shows hope, but does not talk after the death of her parents, which becomes the subject of harassment among other athletes. By standing up for Dima, one of the guys on the team, she gets her first r

credits.title: Clipmakers
credits.overview: A ravishing comedy about controversial post-Soviet Russia of the 90s with storylines of four friends in the world of the glam-our entertainment industry closely tangled with criminals. The movie savors the final moments of the golden age of Russian clip makers full of easy money, dolce vita and danger.

credits.title: In the Circle of Their Own
credits.overview: The story of a girl who perceives the world, pain and joy exclusively through sounds.

credits.title: Freeze Dance
credits.overview: Kolya and Sasha hide away in an old lodge in the middle of the forest. They are in love, and the world around seems strange and wonderful. credits.title: To Be Victor Pelevin. By Whom?
credits.overview: Vitya, a 40-year-old taxi driver who aspired to become a writer in his youth, leaves this dream after a series of failures. He lives quietly in a communal apartment with idle neighbors, delivers hated passengers all over Moscow every day. One day Vitya decides to pretend to be the mysterious Viktor Pelevin.

credits.title: INSIGHT
credits.overview: A beautiful Deya God descends from heaven in female form, who dreams of helping people who are entangled in compromises and endless pretense.

credits.title: The Blackout
credits.overview: Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small ring-like area in Eastern Europe still has electricity, and maybe even life is being reported from space. What military forces find outside the ring is shocking.

credits.title: Thunderstorm
credits.overview: The action unfolds in our days, in the small Volga town of Kalinov, where nothing has changed since the days of Alexander Ostrovsky’s classical play: if any rays of light do appear in the dark empire, then they are doomed to perish quietly in the general absurdity and ignorance, or shine brightly as a token of protest

credits.title: Cafe Midnight
credits.overview: The three girls lived happily in their little fairy-tale world until reality began to affect their lives.
